name: app-hopper
title: App Hopper
description: Find and switch between running apps, windows, and browser tabs.
author: chenghsj

commands.name: app-hopper
commands.title: App Hopper
commands.description: Search running apps, windows, and browser tabs on macOS and switch to the result you need.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
